seller.whyWeAcquire: Why we acquire properties in Turin
seller.para1: Jungle Rent was born from the vision of optimizing the student rental market in Turin, a continuously growing university city with over 90,000 students between Politecnico di Torino, University of Turin (UniTo), ESCP Business School and IED. seller.para2: Our mission is to acquire strategically positioned apartments in university areas and transform them into modern and optimized housing: comfortable shared spaces, well-furnished single rooms, included services and professional management. seller.para4: We work with specialized notaries and lawyers to guarantee safe and fast transactions. Our valuation is based on weekly updated market analysis, considering location, size, property condition and optimization potential for the rental market.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to your questions
faq.studentQ1: Which areas of Turin do you cover?
faq.studentA1: We operate in Turin's most strategic university areas: Vanchiglia, Vanchiglietta and Sassi (near Politecnico and San Salvario area), Lingotto and Ospedali (ideal for UniTo students), Aurora, Cenisia, Cit Turin and Crocetta (well connected to the city center). All our solutions are maximum 20 minutes from the main university campuses by public transport.
faq.studentQ2: What is the average monthly price for a room?
faq.studentA2: The average rent is €490 per month, significantly lower than the €600-700 requested by traditional agencies. This 25-30% saving is possible thanks to our direct model without intermediaries. All our prices are transparent with no hidden commission costs.
faq.studentQ3: What does the rent price include?
faq.studentA3: The €490 rent covers the room rental. Utilities (electricity, gas, water, internet, heating) are separate and are divided equally among tenants, with an estimated cost of €80-120 per month per person depending on consumption and season. We always provide a transparent expense report.
faq.studentQ4: What is the minimum contract duration?
faq.studentA4: We offer temporary contracts with study motivation for a minimum duration of 9 months (September-May), aligned with the academic year. This type of contract is specifically designed for university students and guarantees greater flexibility compared to traditional 4+4 contracts, with the possibility of year-by-year renewal.
faq.studentQ5: Is it possible to visit the rooms before booking?
faq.studentA5: Absolutely yes! We organize both in-person visits (if you're already in Turin) and guided video calls for international or out-of-town students. Our team responds within 24 hours to schedule an appointment. You can also request additional photos and videos of common areas and the neighborhood.
faq.studentQ6: Do you accept international students? Are special documents required?
faq.studentA6: Yes, we welcome students from all over the world! Required documents are: Italian university enrollment certificate (also for Erasmus or exchange programs), valid ID or passport, and Italian tax code (we'll help you get one if you don't have it). We offer support in English and complete assistance with contract registration.
faq.investorQ1: What is the minimum investment required?
faq.investorA1: The minimum investment starts from €100 thanks to our real estate crowdfunding model. This allows access to the Turin real estate market even with limited capital. For those wanting greater exposure, we offer packages of €5,000, €25,000 and €50,000 with progressively more advantageous conditions. The maximum investment per project is €100,000.
faq.investorQ2: What kind of returns can I expect?
faq.investorA2: Historical returns have averaged around 7% gross per year, but are not guaranteed and depend on the Turin real estate market trend and occupancy rate. WARNING: this does not constitute a promise of return nor a contractual obligation. Real estate investments involve risks, including possible partial or total loss of invested capital. We always recommend diversifying your portfolio.
faq.investorQ3: Does Jungle Rent manage the property completely?
faq.investorA3: Yes, we offer a full-service management service that includes: tenant search and selection, contract management and registrations, ordinary and extraordinary maintenance, rent collection, arrears management, legal assistance, and detailed quarterly reporting. The investor receives passive income without having to worry about anything.
faq.investorQ4: How long does it take to see the first returns?
faq.investorA4: The first return is paid after approximately 2 months from investment, once the setup phase is completed (purchase/renovation, tenant search, contract registration). Subsequently, returns are distributed quarterly via bank transfer. You will also receive a quarterly report with details of your investment's performance.
faq.investorQ5: What type of contracts are offered to tenants?
faq.investorA5: We use temporary contracts with study motivation (art. 5 L. 431/98) lasting 9-10 months, renewable annually. This type was chosen because it's perfectly aligned with student demand, guarantees greater rotation (therefore rent adjustment to market rates), tax benefits (10% flat-rate tax), and legal protection for both owner and tenant. All contracts are regularly registered with the Italian Revenue Agency.
faq.generalQ1: Who are you and how long have you been operating?
faq.generalA1: Jungle Rent was born from the direct experience of real estate investors and financial professionals who personally experienced the difficulties of finding housing as students away from home. Since 2023 we've been operating in Turin with the mission of democratizing access to both rental and real estate investment. We are partners of 2i3T, the Politecnico di Torino incubator, which validates the solidity of our business model and supports us in strategic growth.
faq.generalA2: You can contact us in several ways: WhatsApp at +39 331 905 3037 (response within 2 hours during business hours), email at info@junglerent.com, or by filling out the dedicated forms on the site for students, investors or sellers. Our team speaks Italian and English. The office is at via Paolo Sacchi 46, Turin, and we are available for meetings by appointment.
